notes: The page does not give the year for Nov 1 and Feb 1; the year is inferred from the line that the new program starts in summer 2027. The application site names this program and offers sign up (checked 2026-11-02); the screens past sign up were not read. Pay is not posted.
name: Summer High School Career Exploration Program
what_you_do: A one month summer program. You learn by doing and grow work skills with experts across the hospital. It replaces the earlier paid summer internship.
who_can_apply: At least 17 years old, a US citizen or green card holder, graduating from a Cincinnati area high school in spring 2027, living within one hour's drive of Cincinnati, planning to attend an undergraduate school in fall 2027, and interested in a career in biomedical sciences.
pay_detail: Not stated for the new program. The program page, checked on 2026-11-02, says nothing about pay. The old program was a paid, part-time position.
duration: June 14 to July 8, 2027, Monday to Thursday, 24 hours a week (no program July 5)
deadline_text: Online application opened Nov 1 and closes Feb 1, 2027 at 5 PM EST, for summer 2027.
how_to_apply: Register on the application site, complete the eligibility quiz, then finish the application and press the final submit button before Feb 1 at 5 PM EST. There is no automatic submission. Questions: hssummerinternship@cchmc.org.
